title: On the Effects of Data Scale on UI Control Agents
authors_zh: Wei Li, William Bishop, Alice Li, Chris Rawles, Folawiyo Campbell-Ajala, Divya Tyamagundlu, Oriana Riva
paper_type_zh: 移动 UI 智能体轨迹数据集与规模研究
best_for_zh: 研究移动智能体 SFT、离线动作评测、轨迹数据规模效应与环境复现审计的读者
one_line: AndroidControl releases 15,283 human Android demonstrations with paired high-/low-level instructions and uses offline next-action matching to show that in-domain SFT scales much faster than out-of-domain high-level control.
AndroidControl 发布 15,283 条带高层目标与逐动作指令的人类 Android 示范，并以离线下一动作匹配研究数据规模；其分数不等同于在线任务成功，复用仍受许可证冲突与不可回放环境限制。
why: It is both a reusable offline mobile-agent trajectory object and a warning about feedback boundaries: reported scores measure agreement with one demonstrated next action, while replay state, discarded failures, release versioning, and licensing remain incompletely specified.
inclusion_reason: AndroidControl is a directly released state-action trajectory corpus whose paired high-/low-level human instructions, broad app coverage, controlled ID/OOD splits, and data-scale experiments expose how trajectory supervision and offline action matching shape mobile-agent SFT and evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The final NeurIPS proceedings record identifies this work as a 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track paper; the official OpenReview listing marks it as a Spotlight. The paper asks whether supervised fine-tuning on larger collections of human UI demonstrations can by itself produce robust real-world control, and whether in-domain scaling behavior transfers to unseen apps, tasks, and categories (NeurIPS paper, Abstract and §§1–2).

AndroidControl addresses a data bottleneck rather than proposing a new online agent environment. It releases 15,283 human demonstrations covering 14,548 unique tasks, 833 Android apps, and 40 app categories, with an average of 5.5 steps per episode. Unlike a prompt-answer dataset, one episode binds a high-level goal and per-action low-level instructions to screenshot and accessibility-tree observations plus JSON actions (Paper Table 1, p. 3; Appendix B.2, pp. 14–15).

This object belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the released unit is a full physical-device state-action episode, and in data_construction_open_release_recipes because the paper documents task seeding, human collection, filtering, split construction, and SeqIO transformation. The adjacent problem it does not cover is reproducible online execution: app versions, APKs, account/reset state, network state, companion collection software, and an executable success predicate are not released.

The Card is content-complete for bilingual research screening using the official paper, appendices, datasheet, repository, bucket inventory, and split manifests. That evidence supports offline SFT and evaluation analysis, but not a claim that the corpus is an immutable replay benchmark or cleared for unrestricted reuse; the contradictory license statements and unexamined TFRecord contents remain explicit audit boundaries.

NeurIPS 最终 proceedings 条目将该工作列为 2024 年 Datasets and Benchmarks Track 论文，官方 OpenReview 条目将其标为 Spotlight。论文研究的问题是：仅依靠规模更大的人类 UI 操作示范进行监督微调，能否得到稳健的真实世界控制能力，以及域内的规模规律能否迁移到未见 app、任务和类别（NeurIPS 论文摘要及第 1–2 节）。

AndroidControl 解决的是数据瓶颈，而不是提出新的在线智能体环境。它发布 15,283 条人类示范，覆盖 14,548 个独立任务、833 个 Android app 和 40 个 app 类别，每个 episode 平均 5.5 步。其单条对象不是普通问答，而是把高层目标和逐动作低层指令，与 screenshot、accessibility tree 观测及 JSON 动作绑定在一起（论文表 1，第 3 页；附录 B.2，第 14–15 页）。

该对象属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为发布单元是物理设备上的完整状态—动作 episode；它也属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为论文说明了任务种子、人类采集、过滤、划分和 SeqIO 转换。它不覆盖相邻的可复现在线执行问题：app 版本、APK、账号与重置状态、网络状态、采集配套软件及可执行成功谓词均未发布。

本卡依据官方论文、附录、datasheet、仓库、bucket inventory 与 split manifest，已具备用于双语研究筛选的内容完整度。这些证据支持对离线 SFT 与评测的分析，但不能据此宣称该语料是不可变回放 benchmark，或已获准不受限制地复用；互相矛盾的许可证表述与未逐条检查的 TFRecord 内容仍是明确的审计边界。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a paired-granularity trajectory corpus plus a controlled scale study: humans execute Android tasks on physical phones while recording both a task-level goal and an instruction immediately before each action, after which the same episodes are transformed into high-level-only (HL) and low-plus-high-level (LL) state-action examples (Paper §3.1, pp. 4–5; §4.2, pp. 6–7).

One released episode contains episode_id, goal, PNG screenshots, serialized accessibility_trees, screenshot dimensions, JSON actions, and step_instructions. Actions sit between consecutive screenshots, so there is one fewer action than observation; low-level instructions align one-to-one with actions and may repeat when an instruction requires multiple actions (Appendix B.2, pp. 14–15; official repository README, “Dataset format”). The native action space is click, long_press, input_text, scroll, navigate_home, navigate_back, open_app, and wait (Paper Table 2, p. 5).

The feedback contract is programmatic but narrow. Offline step accuracy compares a predicted next action and its arguments with the human reference, allowing only specified equivalences: a coordinate inside the target element bounds, navigate_back versus clicking an on-screen Back element, and open_app versus clicking matching app text (Paper §4.2, p. 7; Appendix D.3, pp. 20–21). It observes agreement with one demonstrated next action; it does not observe live task completion, delayed side effects, recovery after an error, or many alternative valid routes. Collection-time labels of successful, infeasible, or failed are human judgments, while the terminate action used by SeqIO is a training-only insertion rather than a released executable terminal predicate (Paper §3.1, p. 5; Appendix C.2 and D.1).

Relative to UI-control datasets summarized in Table 1, including Android in the Wild as a baseline source for zero-shot evaluation, AndroidControl’s distinguishing object is the joint high-/low-level human instruction structure across broad app coverage, paired with explicit IDD, app-unseen, task-unseen, and category-unseen analysis. The research direction is supervised trajectory scaling under distribution shift, not RL reward design or online environment construction.

该工作的贡献是双粒度轨迹语料与受控规模研究：人类在物理手机上执行 Android 任务，同时记录任务级目标和每个动作前即时输入的指令；随后，同一批 episode 被转换为仅含高层指令的 HL 状态—动作样本，以及同时包含低层和高层指令的 LL 状态—动作样本（论文第 3.1 节，第 4–5 页；第 4.2 节，第 6–7 页）。

一条发布的 episode 包含 episode_id、goal、PNG screenshots、序列化 accessibility_trees、截图尺寸、JSON actions 与 step_instructions。动作位于相邻截图之间，因此动作数比观测数少一个；低层指令与动作一一对齐，当一条指令需要多个动作时可以重复（附录 B.2，第 14–15 页；官方仓库 README 的 “Dataset format”）。原生动作空间包括 click、long_press、input_text、scroll、navigate_home、navigate_back、open_app 和 wait（论文表 2，第 5 页）。

其反馈契约是程序化但狭窄的。离线 step accuracy 将预测的下一动作及参数与人类参考动作比较，仅放宽三类等价：坐标落在目标元素边界内、navigate_back 与点击屏幕 Back 元素等价、open_app 与点击匹配 app 名称的文本等价（论文第 4.2 节，第 7 页；附录 D.3，第 20–21 页）。它能观察与单条人类下一动作的一致性，却不能观察在线任务完成、延迟副作用、错误后的恢复或许多其他有效路径。采集时的 successful、infeasible、failed 是人工判断；SeqIO 使用的 terminate 动作则是训练时插入项，不是发布的可执行 terminal predicate（论文第 3.1 节，第 5 页；附录 C.2 与 D.1）。

相较论文表 1 总结的 UI 控制数据集，包括作为 zero-shot 评测基线来源的 Android in the Wild，AndroidControl 的区别在于跨大量 app 联合提供人类高层与低层指令，并明确分析 IDD、app-unseen、task-unseen 和 category-unseen 划分。它代表的是分布偏移下的监督轨迹规模研究，而不是 RL reward 设计或在线环境构建。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and collection. An undisclosed LLM generates generic feature descriptions for 40 app categories. Twenty trained paid contractors choose apps, instantiate concrete tasks, write a high-level goal, and enter a low-level instruction before every action. Demonstrations were collected from April 2023 through April 2024 on physical Google Pixel phones running Android 8.0 or later through a companion Android app, Chrome web app, WebUSB, and ADB; the final four months introduced 20 LLM-generated personas (Paper §3.1, pp. 4–5; supplementary datasheet §1.1.3, p. 2). The exact LLM snapshots, prompts, decoding settings, and record-level persona assignments are unknown.

Interaction and retention. At every step, the recorder keeps a full-resolution PNG screenshot, serialized accessibility tree, and the next JSON action with arguments. Annotators label traces successful, infeasible, or failed. Failed/error episodes and raw discarded events are removed, while typos and grammatical errors in instructions are retained; scroll gestures are reduced to four directions (Paper §3.1, p. 5; datasheet §§1.1.2 and 1.1.4, pp. 2–3). The release does not expose a documented top-level status field, per-record quality ledger, adjudication process, failed episode count, or preprocessing code.

Released output and splits. The output is 20 GZIP TFRecord shards plus splits.json and test_subsplits.json. Paper Table 3 reports train 13,604 episodes/74,722 steps and validation 137/690; test subsets are IDD 721/3,897, app-unseen 631/3,475, task-unseen 803/4,464, and category-unseen 700/3,891. These test subsets can overlap and must not be summed. Direct inspection of the official manifest instead finds 13,603 train IDs, 137 validation IDs, and 1,543 test IDs; the one-episode train discrepancy is unresolved (Paper §3.3 and Table 3, pp. 5–6; official splits.json and test_subsplits.json, checked 2026-07-20).

Training transformation. SeqIO creates an HL task using only the goal and an LL task using both goal and current step instruction. Each input contains instruction text, a flattened textual accessibility-tree view of the current screen, and action history; the target is the next action. The evaluated agent does not consume screenshots. Element-based click/long-press targets without a matching accessibility node remain in history but are dropped as targets; LL targets without low-level instructions are also dropped, and an episode is removed only if all steps are discarded. SeqIO appends the training-only terminate(successful|infeasible) action (Paper §4.1–4.2, pp. 6–7; Appendix C.1–C.2 and D.1, pp. 16–19).

Model, sampling, and evaluation. PaLM-2S is LoRA-tuned on an HL/LL mixture. Scaling subsets randomly contain 5, 10, 100, 1k, 10k, or all paper-reported 13,604 training episodes; LoRA rank is 4 below 1k and 64 at 1k or more, decoding temperature is 0, and the best checkpoint is selected on validation. Offline next-action matching supplies the evaluation signal. Optimizer, learning rate, batch size, training seed, exact compute, and complete checkpoint policy are unknown (Paper §4.2, pp. 6–7; Figure 5 caption, p. 9).

Reproduction therefore requires pinning all shard hashes, both split files, a repository commit, and the paper version, then reimplementing collection preprocessing, SeqIO conversion, reference matching, and model training. No official training code, preprocessing code, evaluation script, configuration, checkpoint, tagged release, or replay environment is available in the checked repository; only the README and images are present, and the paper checklist states that code is not provided.

输入与采集。 一个未披露的 LLM 为 40 个 app 类别生成通用功能描述。20 名受过训练的付费承包人员选择 app、把描述实例化为具体任务、写入高层目标，并在每个动作前输入低层指令。采集于 2023 年 4 月至 2024 年 4 月进行，使用运行 Android 8.0 或更高版本的物理 Google Pixel 手机，以及配套 Android app、Chrome web app、WebUSB 和 ADB；最后四个月引入了 20 个 LLM 生成的 persona（论文第 3.1 节，第 4–5 页；补充 datasheet 第 1.1.3 节，第 2 页）。精确 LLM 版本、prompt、解码设置和逐记录 persona 分配均为 unknown。

交互与保留。 记录器在每一步保存全分辨率 PNG screenshot、序列化 accessibility tree，以及带参数的下一条 JSON 动作。标注者将轨迹标为 successful、infeasible 或 failed。failed/error episode 与原始废弃事件被删除，指令中的拼写和语法错误则保留；scroll 手势被约化为四个方向（论文第 3.1 节，第 5 页；datasheet 第 1.1.2 与 1.1.4 节，第 2–3 页）。发布没有提供文档化的顶层 status 字段、逐记录质量 ledger、裁决流程、失败 episode 数量或预处理代码。

发布输出与划分。 输出包含 20 个 GZIP TFRecord shard，以及 splits.json 和 test_subsplits.json。论文表 3 报告训练集为 13,604 个 episode/74,722 步，验证集为 137/690；测试子集分别为 IDD 721/3,897、app-unseen 631/3,475、task-unseen 803/4,464、category-unseen 700/3,891。这些测试子集可能重叠，不能直接相加。对官方 manifest 的直接检查则得到 13,603 个训练 ID、137 个验证 ID 和 1,543 个测试 ID；训练集相差一条的原因仍未解决（论文第 3.3 节及表 3，第 5–6 页；官方 splits.json 与 test_subsplits.json，核验于 2026-07-20）。

训练转换。 SeqIO 构造仅使用目标的 HL 任务，以及同时使用目标和当前 step instruction 的 LL 任务。每个输入包含指令文本、当前屏幕 accessibility tree 的扁平文本表示和动作历史；目标是下一动作。被评测智能体不使用 screenshot。对于找不到匹配 accessibility node 的 click/long-press，相关步骤仍保留在历史中，但不作为训练目标；缺少低层指令的 LL 目标也被丢弃，只有所有步骤都被丢弃时才删除整个 episode。SeqIO 还会插入仅用于训练的 terminate(successful|infeasible) 动作（论文第 4.1–4.2 节，第 6–7 页；附录 C.1–C.2 与 D.1，第 16–19 页）。

模型、采样与评测。 PaLM-2S 以 LoRA 在 HL/LL 混合数据上微调。规模子集从论文所报的 13,604 条训练 episode 中随机抽取 5、10、100、1k、10k 或全部样本；少于 1k 时 LoRA rank 为 4，达到 1k 后为 64；解码 temperature 为 0，并按验证集选择最佳 checkpoint。评测信号来自离线下一动作匹配。optimizer、learning rate、batch size、训练 seed、精确 compute 和完整 checkpoint 策略均为 unknown（论文第 4.2 节，第 6–7 页；图 5 caption，第 9 页）。

因此，复现必须固定所有 shard 哈希、两个 split 文件、仓库 commit 与论文版本，并重写采集预处理、SeqIO 转换、参考动作匹配和模型训练。已检查的官方仓库只有 README 与图片，没有训练代码、预处理代码、评测脚本、配置、checkpoint、tagged release 或回放环境；论文 checklist 也明确说明未提供代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Random-500 IDD, the fine-tuned LT-all-r64 PaLM-2S reaches 71.5% HL and 86.6% LL step accuracy. The strongest reported zero-shot values in the same table are 42.1% HL for M3A/GPT-4 Turbo and 56.7% LL for AitW/PaLM-2L (Paper Table 4, p. 8). Appendix E.3 checks the 500-action shortcut against the full test: zero-shot PaLM-2L scores 35.2/43.0 on Random-500 versus 35.0/42.7 on full-test HL/LL, while fine-tuned PaLM-2S scores 62.6/82.2 versus 64.8/80.0 (Table 12, p. 22).

Distribution shift remains substantial. On full splits, LT-all-r64 reports 70.8% HL and 83.2% LL on IDD, but only 57.4–59.6% HL and 76.8–78.5% LL across app-, task-, and category-unseen subsets. The authors report that the OOD gap grows as more training data is added (Paper Table 5 and §4.5, p. 9). On Random-500, HL accuracy is 82.5% for Google first-party apps but 58.7% for third-party apps (Appendix E.5, Table 13, p. 23).

Step accuracy also overstates long-horizon reliability. Fine-tuned episode accuracy falls from 21.3% for five-step tasks to 7.6% for six-step tasks despite reported step accuracy in the 64–71% range; zero-shot systems complete no tasks longer than five steps. The training-only terminate action is especially difficult, with action-type accuracy of 38.6% for HL and 67.5% for LL (Appendix E.1 and E.4, Tables 8–9 and Figure 9 discussion, pp. 21–23).

The headline scale targets are extrapolations rather than observations. Log-linear fits project 500K and 1M episodes for 95% IDD LL and HL step accuracy, 2M for 95% completion of a five-step IDD HL episode, 10M and 60M for 95% OOD LL and HL step accuracy, and 150M for 95% completion of a five-step OOD HL episode (Paper §§4.4–4.5, pp. 8–9). Those estimates depend on the fitted regime and, for episode completion, an independence assumption; they do not demonstrate that datasets of those sizes were collected or trained.

All results are author-reported and not independently reproduced in the checked artifacts. They support the claims that paired instructions and more in-domain demonstrations improve reference-action agreement, and that OOD high-level control scales more slowly. They do not establish per-record trajectory quality, live environment success, causal attribution to data scale alone, contamination freedom, or unrestricted reuse rights.

在 Random-500 IDD 上，微调后的 LT-all-r64 PaLM-2S 达到 71.5% HL 与 86.6% LL step accuracy。同一表中最强的 zero-shot 数值分别是 M3A/GPT-4 Turbo 的 42.1% HL，以及 AitW/PaLM-2L 的 56.7% LL（论文表 4，第 8 页）。附录 E.3 将 500 动作近似与完整测试比较：zero-shot PaLM-2L 在 Random-500 上为 35.2/43.0，在完整测试上为 35.0/42.7（HL/LL）；微调 PaLM-2S 则分别为 62.6/82.2 与 64.8/80.0（表 12，第 22 页）。

分布偏移仍然显著。在完整划分上，LT-all-r64 的 IDD 为 70.8% HL 和 83.2% LL，而 app-unseen、task-unseen 与 category-unseen 子集仅为 57.4–59.6% HL 和 76.8–78.5% LL。作者报告 OOD 差距会随训练数据增加而扩大（论文表 5 与第 4.5 节，第 9 页）。在 Random-500 上，Google 第一方 app 的 HL 准确率为 82.5%，第三方 app 则为 58.7%（附录 E.5，表 13，第 23 页）。

step accuracy 也会高估长时程可靠性。尽管报告的 step accuracy 位于 64–71% 区间，微调模型的 episode accuracy 从五步任务的 21.3% 降至六步任务的 7.6%；zero-shot 系统没有完成任何超过五步的任务。仅用于训练的 terminate 动作尤其困难，其 action-type accuracy 为 HL 38.6%、LL 67.5%（附录 E.1 与 E.4，表 8–9 及图 9 讨论，第 21–23 页）。

论文强调的规模目标是外推而不是实测。log-linear 拟合推算：达到 95% IDD step accuracy，LL 与 HL 分别需要 500K 和 1M 条 episode；达到五步 IDD HL episode 的 95% 完成率需要 2M；达到 95% OOD step accuracy，LL 与 HL 分别需要 10M 和 60M；达到五步 OOD HL episode 的 95% 完成率需要 150M（论文第 4.4–4.5 节，第 8–9 页）。这些估计依赖拟合区间，episode 完成率还依赖独立性假设；它们不表示论文实际采集或训练了这些规模的数据。

以上结果均由作者报告，已检查 artifact 中没有独立复现。它们支持两个限定结论：双粒度指令和更多域内示范能提高与参考动作的一致性，OOD 高层控制的扩展更慢；但不能据此证明逐记录轨迹质量、在线环境成功、性能只由数据规模导致、数据无污染或复用权利不受限制。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior UI-control datasets in the paper’s Table 1 provide combinations of demonstrations, screen observations, and instructions; Android in the Wild also serves as a transfer baseline in the experiments. AndroidControl changes the supervised object by pairing a human task-level goal with a human instruction before every action, while covering 14,548 unique tasks across 833 apps. This supports a controlled comparison between HL inputs, which require the model to infer intermediate steps, and LL inputs, which expose the current subgoal (Paper Table 1, pp. 3–4; §4.2, pp. 6–7).

The second concrete change is the evaluation design around data scale and distribution shift. The study subsamples 5 through all available training episodes and reports IDD, app-unseen, task-unseen, and category-unseen surfaces, rather than treating one aggregate offline score as sufficient. That makes the release a direction signal for asking whether more demonstrations improve reference-action imitation uniformly or mainly densify known apps and task templates.

What is not new remains important. The work does not introduce Android, accessibility-tree control, human behavior cloning, LoRA, PaLM-2, offline next-action accuracy, or an online reward interface. Its collection pipeline uses an LLM only to seed generic feature descriptions and personas; target actions and instructions come from humans. The release is neither an RLVR dataset nor a replayable environment, and the reported scale itself is not a record-level quality signal.

For reasoning-data research, the useful novelty is the combination of instruction granularity, full episode context, and controlled distribution-shift scaling. Before reusing it, a builder still must reconcile the 13,604/13,603 training-count mismatch, determine which collection statuses are serialized, inspect the shards, resolve the license conflict, and recreate the omitted SeqIO and evaluation logic. Without those checks, the novelty supports study design but not a fully reproducible training claim.

论文表 1 中的既有 UI 控制数据集已经提供不同组合的示范、屏幕观测与指令；Android in the Wild 也在实验中作为迁移基线。AndroidControl 对监督对象的改变，是同时提供人类任务级目标与每个动作前的人类指令，并覆盖 833 个 app 上的 14,548 个独立任务。这使研究者可以受控比较 HL 输入与 LL 输入：前者要求模型自行推断中间步骤，后者直接给出当前子目标（论文表 1，第 3–4 页；第 4.2 节，第 6–7 页）。

第二项具体变化是围绕数据规模与分布偏移组织评测。研究从 5 条到全部可用训练 episode 逐级采样，并分别报告 IDD、app-unseen、task-unseen 与 category-unseen 评测面，而不是只给出一个聚合离线分数。由此，该发布能用于研究：增加示范是否均匀提高参考动作模仿，还是主要让已知 app 与任务模板变得更密集。

哪些内容并非新贡献也必须明确。该工作没有提出 Android、基于 accessibility tree 的控制、人类行为克隆、LoRA、PaLM-2、离线下一动作准确率或在线 reward 接口。采集管线中的 LLM 只用于生成通用功能描述和 persona；目标动作与指令由人类提供。该发布既不是 RLVR 数据集，也不是可回放环境；其规模本身也不是逐记录质量信号。

对 reasoning data 研究而言，有用的新意是把指令粒度、完整 episode 上下文与受控分布偏移规模研究结合起来。复用前，构建者仍需解释 13,604/13,603 的训练数量差异，确定哪些采集状态被序列化，检查 shard，解决许可证冲突，并重建缺失的 SeqIO 与评测逻辑。在这些检查完成前，该新意可以支撑研究设计，却不能支撑完全可复现的训练结论。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Feedback limitation: offline single-reference matching can mark an alternative valid route or corrective action wrong, while rewarding an action that matches the trace but would later fail. The metric is next-action imitation, not a live task-success verifier; this creates both false negatives and false positives relative to the intended UI-control behavior (Paper §5, p. 10; curator inference from Appendix D.3).
  • Release and replay limitation: screenshots, accessibility trees, and actions are available, but app/APK versions, accounts, reset state, network/service state, companion collection code, preprocessing code, evaluation code, and an executable terminal predicate are not pinned. Version drift can therefore change whether an action remains valid, and the released episodes cannot be immutably replayed.
  • Selection and lineage limitation: failed/error episodes, raw events, and discarded traces were removed and are not released. The exact successful/infeasible counts, serialized status field, annotator/persona IDs, review decisions, and adjudication records are unknown, so users cannot measure how filtering removed hard cases or biased the retained behavior (Datasheet §§1.1.2 and 1.1.4, pp. 2–3).
  • Split and contamination limitation: Table 3 reports 13,604 training episodes, but official splits.json contains 13,603 train IDs. No near-duplicate, task-template-overlap, or downstream benchmark decontamination procedure is disclosed. The four OOD test subsets overlap, so treating their counts as disjoint would also misstate evaluation coverage.
  • Rights and participant limitation: the README, repository root license, and paper checklist say Apache-2.0, whereas the supplementary datasheet also says the dataset is free only for non-commercial purposes. This official-source conflict, plus unclear third-party app/UI-content rights, blocks an unqualified training-reuse recommendation. The authors report informed paid contractors using non-personal devices, but wage amount, total compensation, and record-level consent audit are undisclosed (Appendix B.1, p. 14; checklist p. 25).
  • Generalization and extrapolation limitation: only PaLM-2S is fine-tuned, online inference cost is not studied, app categories are incomplete, and OOD/long-horizon results are weak. Million-scale targets come from log-linear extrapolation and episode-independence assumptions, not observed runs; they should not be treated as a collection prescription without additional models and live-environment validation (Paper §5 and §§4.4–4.5).

• 反馈限制： 离线单参考匹配可能把其他有效路径或纠错动作判错，也可能奖励与轨迹一致但随后会失败的动作。该指标衡量下一动作模仿，不是在线任务成功 verifier；相对于目标 UI 控制行为，它同时可能产生 false negative 与 false positive（论文第 5 节，第 10 页；基于附录 D.3 的 curator inference）。
  • 发布与回放限制： 虽然发布了 screenshot、accessibility tree 与动作，但 app/APK 版本、账号、重置状态、网络与服务状态、采集配套代码、预处理代码、评测代码及可执行 terminal predicate 都未固定。版本漂移可能改变动作是否仍然有效，发布的 episode 也无法进行不可变回放。
  • 选择与 lineage 限制： failed/error episode、原始事件与废弃轨迹被删除且未发布。精确的 successful/infeasible 数量、序列化 status 字段、标注者/persona ID、审核决定与裁决记录均为 unknown，因此用户无法衡量过滤如何移除难例或使保留行为产生偏差（datasheet 第 1.1.2 与 1.1.4 节，第 2–3 页）。
  • 划分与污染限制： 论文表 3 报告 13,604 条训练 episode，官方 splits.json 却只有 13,603 个训练 ID。论文未披露近重复、任务模板重叠或下游 benchmark decontamination 流程。四个 OOD 测试子集互相重叠，若将数量视为互斥相加，也会误报评测覆盖。
  • 权利与参与者限制： README、仓库根许可证和论文 checklist 写明 Apache-2.0，而补充 datasheet 同时称数据仅可免费用于非商业目的。这一官方来源冲突，加上第三方 app/UI 内容权利不明，使本卡不能无条件建议训练复用。作者报告付费承包人员已知情并使用非个人设备，但工资数额、总报酬与逐记录 consent 审计未披露（附录 B.1，第 14 页；checklist 第 25 页）。
  • 泛化与外推限制： 论文只微调 PaLM-2S，没有研究在线 inference 成本，app 类别并不完整，OOD 与长时程结果较弱。百万级规模目标来自 log-linear 外推和 episode 独立性假设，而非真实运行；在增加模型与在线环境验证前，不应将其直接当作采集配方（论文第 5 节及第 4.4–4.5 节）。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, AndroidControl is useful as an offline state-action corpus: builders can train an accessibility-tree agent with high-level goals, compare it with low-level subgoal conditioning, and audit how action history and episode length affect compounding error. Preserve the full episode container, original goal, every step instruction, screenshots, accessibility trees, action arguments, and split membership rather than flattening records without lineage.

For data_construction_open_release_recipes, the paper supplies a concrete design for combining LLM-seeded task coverage with human execution, paired instruction granularities, explicit app/task/category shift, and scale sweeps. A faithful replication should also keep the evidence the release omits: feature/persona prompt versions, annotator and device/app versions, raw status, rejection reasons, preprocessing logs, and a manifest tying shards to code and paper versions.

The offline matching rules are a useful evaluation baseline and an audit target. Researchers can compare strict single-reference accuracy with live completion, multi-reference routes, recovery-aware metrics, or state-change verifiers; difficult terminate decisions and the first-/third-party app gap provide concrete failure slices. The 13,604/13,603 discrepancy is also a compact test of whether a pipeline privileges prose counts or the executable split manifest.

Reuse class: blocked pending verification for unrestricted training reuse; usable for evaluation and audit reference under the official access terms after pinning a release snapshot. The contradictory license statements require clarification before training or redistribution, and the corpus does not support replayable online evaluation without reconstructing the environment. Reported benchmark gains motivate these experiments but do not certify trajectory quality.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data 方向而言，AndroidControl 可作为离线状态—动作语料：构建者可用高层目标训练 accessibility-tree 智能体，与低层子目标条件进行比较，并审计动作历史和 episode 长度如何造成误差累积。复用时应保留完整 episode 容器、原始目标、每步指令、screenshot、accessibility tree、动作参数与 split 归属，不能在丢失 lineage 的情况下只保留扁平样本。

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，论文给出一种具体设计：以 LLM 生成的任务覆盖种子结合人类执行，配对两种指令粒度，明确划分 app/task/category shift，并进行规模扫描。忠实复现还应保留原发布缺失的证据，包括功能/persona prompt 版本、标注者、设备与 app 版本、原始 status、拒绝原因、预处理日志，以及将 shard、代码和论文版本绑定在一起的 manifest。

离线匹配规则既是有用的评测 baseline，也是审计对象。研究者可将严格单参考准确率与在线完成、多参考路径、考虑恢复的指标或状态变化 verifier 比较；困难的 terminate 判断，以及第一方/第三方 app 差距，提供了具体 failure slice。13,604/13,603 的数量差异也能直接检验数据管线究竟以论文文字还是可执行 split manifest 为准。

复用等级：不受限制的训练复用在核验完成前受阻；固定发布快照并遵守官方访问条款后，可用于评测与审计参考。互相矛盾的许可证表述必须在训练或再分发前澄清；若不重建环境，该语料也不支持可回放的在线评测。论文报告的 benchmark 提升可以说明这些实验值得开展，但不能认证轨迹质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Paper Table 1 and Appendix B.2: the reusable object is 15,283 full episodes with paired instruction granularities, not an online Android environment.
  • Read Appendix D.3 before interpreting scores: step accuracy is relaxed matching to one demonstrated next action, not live task completion.
  • Keep the split discrepancy visible: Table 3 says 13,604 training episodes, while official splits.json contains 13,603 train IDs.
  • Treat the million-episode targets in §§4.4–4.5 as log-linear extrapolations; no dataset or training run at those scales is reported.
  • Read this with Android in the Wild for the closest transfer baseline, and with replayable mobile-agent environments to see what AndroidControl does not release.
  • Resolve the Apache-2.0 versus non-commercial-only conflict, pin shard/split hashes, and inspect TFRecord status fields before training or redistribution.

• 先读论文表 1 与附录 B.2：可复用对象是 15,283 条带双粒度指令的完整 episode，而不是在线 Android 环境。
  • 解释分数前应先读附录 D.3：step accuracy 是对单条人类下一动作的放宽匹配，不是在线任务完成率。
  • 必须保留划分差异：论文表 3 写明 13,604 条训练 episode，官方 splits.json 却只有 13,603 个训练 ID。
  • 第 4.4–4.5 节的百万级目标应视为 log-linear 外推；论文没有报告相应规模的数据集或训练运行。
  • 可与 Android in the Wild 一起阅读以理解最接近的迁移基线，也应对照可回放移动智能体环境，辨认 AndroidControl 没有发布的部分。
  • 训练或再分发前，应解决 Apache-2.0 与“仅非商业用途”之间的冲突，固定 shard/split 哈希，并检查 TFRecord 中的 status 字段。
